title: Bare WorkspaceClient() fails on serverless/SEG executors; build the SDK client from resolved host/token creds
answers: Model load fails on serverless compute with 'default auth: cannot configure default credentials'
Unity Catalog model download works on classic cluster but not on serverless or SEG
How should the Databricks SDK workspace client be created inside MLflow artifact repos?
body:
Symptom: Loading or registering a Unity Catalog model from serverless or internet-restricted (SEG) compute fails with a default-auth error ('default auth: cannot configure default credentials').
Root cause: mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:_get_databricks_workspace_client called a bare WorkspaceClient(). Spark executors on serverless have no default Databricks credentials.
Fix pattern: Resolve creds with get_databricks_host_creds(registry_uri), and when both host and token are present build WorkspaceClient(host=..., token=...). Catch resolution errors, log at debug, and fall back to WorkspaceClient() default auth only when no usable creds exist (classic compute).
Constraints: registry_uri must be threated in from the caller (DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository.__init__). Keep the default-auth fallback so classic compute still works without a token.
applies: Construction of any Databricks SDK client inside mlflow artifact or registry code that runs on executors.
says: Loading registered models from Unity Catalog fails when running on serverless compute clusters.
Serverless jobs crash with credential configuration errors while downloading models from the catalog.
Models download successfully on classic clusters but fail on serverless or secure environments.
Model registration cannot authenticate to the catalog when running on serverless execution nodes.
Allow serverless compute tasks to download registered catalog models without manual authentication setup.
search: In mlflow/store/artifact/databricks_sdk_models_artifact_repo.py:_get_databricks_workspace_client, Databricks SDK WorkspaceClient instances on executors must be constructed using resolved host and token credentials rather than bare default authentication. Credentials are resolved using get_databricks_host_creds(registry_uri), passing host and token to WorkspaceClient when available, and falling back to default auth only when credentials cannot be resolved. The registry_uri is threaded from DatabricksSDKModelsArtifactRepository.__init__, preventing default-auth failures on serverless and internet-restricted SEG executors.
